evidence: Modifies PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage in src/net_processing.cpp, the central handler for incoming P2P messages.
rationale: Extracts monolithic P2P message handling into dedicated helper functions to improve readability and encapsulation. The author and reviewers note that handling all message types inline in a roughly 1,500-line function made message processing difficult to navigate and review. It provides durable structural cleanup to core P2P logic but makes no functional, security, or protocol changes.
